leetcode.description: This case is inspired by the LeetCode problem. The multi-agent version tests distributed computation and communication efficiency.

metadata.theoretical_complexity: O(N log N) or O(N²) - Global/Shuffle

task_description:
**Task: PageRank (One Iteration)**

Compute one iteration of PageRank on a directed graph.

**Data Distribution:**
Total nodes: 16. Edges RANDOMLY distributed. Initial ranks: uniform.

**Your Data (RANDOM edges):**
Agent {agent_id} holds: {input_shard}

**Algorithm:**
rank'[v] = (1-d)/16 + d × Σ(rank[u]/out_degree[u]) for all u→v
where d = 0.85 (damping factor)

**Output:**
Dictionary mapping node_id to rank_value.

**Communication Protocol:**
Topology: All-to-All with message routing along edges.
All agents must submit the same final answer using submit_result(complete_rank_dict).
